segments.title: 第184章 偷吃
segments.content:
Chapter 184: Sneaking a Bite

The only good news was that Yan Zhusheng wasn't like Ying Chanxi or Xu Youyu. One of them liked to snatch blankets in their sleep, and the other liked to sleep on her side and rest her leg on people.

When Yan Zhusheng slept, she was quite well-behaved and proper.

The blanket was pulled up to her chest, her hands resting on her stomach over the blanket, her face peaceful and serene.

After Li Luo sat up in bed and found Yan Zhusheng lying beside him, he should have gotten up and left immediately, but he couldn't help but admire the girl's delicate sleeping face for a while longer.

It wasn't until the sound of slippers shuffling came from the hallway that Li Luo's expression changed, and he quickly got out of bed.

He glanced down at his clothes, and after confirming everything was in order, he pushed open the door with a composed expression.

Xu Youyu, who had just woken up, came out of the study opposite him. She was utterly astonished to see Li Luo emerge from this small bedroom.

"What are you doing in here?"

"Yan Zhusheng came over and said she was still a bit sleepy, so I tidied up this room for her to nap in," Li Luo said, his expression unchanging, his heart not skipping a beat. "What about you? Weren't you sleeping in my bed?"

"Ahem, ahem..." Hearing him say that, Xu Youyu became a little embarrassed. "I was too tired last night and fell asleep by accident. My sleeping posture isn't the best, I didn't disturb your sleep, did I?"

"No." Li Luo blinked. "After I saw you two were asleep, I got you a blanket, and then I didn't sleep in the master bedroom."

"Oh, I see." Xu Youyu nodded in realization. No wonder Li Luo wasn't there when she woke up in the morning.

This guy, Li Luo... he was a little too honest, wasn't he?

Xu Youyu looked at Li Luo, sizing him up and down, then glanced at herself.

"What's wrong?" Li Luo noticed Xu Youyu's strange behavior and asked with concern.

"It's nothing." Xu Youyu shook her head. "Zhusheng is sleeping, and Xixi hasn't woken up yet. Why don't we go buy groceries first?"

"That works."

Li Luo glanced at the time. It was already past ten in the morning.

If they didn't go buy groceries now, they probably wouldn't eat until one or two in the afternoon.

So, Li Luo quickly tidied himself up, went to the master bedroom to grab his down jacket and scarf, and glanced at Ying Chanxi, who was still sleeping soundly in his bed, shaking his head with a helpless smile.

Then, he and the now-ready Xu Youyu left the apartment and headed for the wet market.

"Come to think of it," Xu Youyu recalled, "this seems to be the first time the two of us have gone out to buy groceries alone."

"Is that some kind of record worth celebrating?"

"Just feeling a bit sentimental," Xu Youyu said with a grin. "It's my first time sleeping in a guy's bed, and then going out to buy groceries together right after. Tsk, tsk, it really gets one's imagination running."

One could only say that she truly believed sleeping early helps one grow taller, as she could make suggestive remarks so effortlessly.

Li Luo's lips twitched. "Don't describe a very ordinary little thing as if I did something. We're still very pure."

"Oh, whatever." Xu Youyu patted Li Luo's shoulder. "Speaking of which, I've never gone out to buy groceries alone with a guy before. What do you think guys are usually thinking at a time like this?"

After just a few words, Xu Youyu couldn't help but start gathering material.

Li Luo didn't think much of it, assuming Xu Youyu was just making small talk, so he casually replied, "If a guy and a girl are buying groceries and cooking alone, with no one else around, the guy's mind is probably completely preoccupied with how to trick her into bed and devour her."

"Ooh?" Xu Youyu raised an eyebrow, pressing on with great interest, "Are all guys like that?"

"Probably. I'm just making it up. Besides, most people probably just fantasize about it," Li Luo said. "Of those who would actually take action, it would be good if there's even one in ten."

"Is that so." Xu Youyu seemed lost in thought, then she smiled. "Then what do you guess girls are thinking at a time like this?"

"What are they thinking?"

"If it's someone she likes, then the girl is probably thinking about how to feign a situation where he would make the first move, and then she can be 'conquered' by him amidst some playful resistance."

"You didn't just come up with that on the spot, did you?"

"Of course not."

"Then, senior, could it be that you're thinking that way right now?"

"You're pretty confident in yourself, huh? I said, 'if it's someone she likes.'"

"Then what if it's someone she doesn't like?"

"Then the first step wouldn't even happen," Xu Youyu said with a cheerful smile. "If she doesn't like him, who in their right mind would go buy groceries alone with him?"

"Hmm?"

"What's wrong? What are you thinking about?" Xu Youyu watched him with a half-smile. "We're different, though. After all, Xixi and Zhusheng are still waiting for lunch."

"That's true."

Chatting idly like this, the two soon arrived at the wet market.

Along the way, Xu Youyu asked many more sensitive questions. By the time they finished shopping and returned to Bihai Lanting, she felt she had reaped a great harvest, her inspiration practically overflowing from her mind.

It was mainly because Li Luo was interesting to talk to. Unlike other guys, he wasn't coy when chatting with her and was never afraid to express some very genuine opinions.

This was very similar to Xu Youyu's own temperament.

It made her feel like she had met her match when they talked.

As for other boys their age, she would find them childish after talking for a while. She might as well go home and find a random topic to debate with her dad.

And just as the two returned home and started cooking in the kitchen, Ying Chanxi in the master bedroom finally had her fill of sleep and stretched languidly on Li Luo's bed.

She picked up her phone to check the time, and realizing it was already past eleven in the morning, Ying Chanxi bolted upright in bed and hurriedly got up and left the bedroom.

Then she saw Xu Youyu in the kitchen, wearing the apron she usually wore, assisting Li Luo at his side.

"Huh? Xixi." Xu Youyu noticed Ying Chanxi at the kitchen door and said with a smile, "Go wash up first. We'll call you when the food is ready."

Li Luo, who was stir-frying, heard the commotion and also turned to look at Ying Chanxi. "Remember to brush your hair."

"Ah!" Ying Chanxi covered her head. Only then did she realize that she had just woken up and hadn't even tidied her hair, so it must be a mess.

She quickly fled into the bathroom to hurriedly wash up.

After she had tidied herself up and came out of the bathroom, just as she was about to go to the kitchen to ask if they needed help, the door to the small bedroom opposite the study was suddenly opened.

Yan Zhusheng walked out, rubbing her head with sleepy eyes. When she saw Ying Chanxi, she instinctively opened her arms and gave her a big hug.

"Xixi, good morning..."

Yan Zhusheng was clearly not fully awake yet, mumbling, "It smells so good."

"Zhu-Zhusheng?" Ying Chanxi was stunned for a moment. "What are you doing in here?"

"I went for a morning run with Li Luo, and then I came over." Yan Zhusheng rested her head on Ying Chanxi's shoulder and mumbled, "I was very sleepy, so I took a nap."

"I-I see..." Ying Chanxi roughly understood what Yan Zhusheng meant. Seeing she was still a bit drowsy, she simply led her back into the bathroom.

After splashing her face with water, Yan Zhusheng was instantly wide awake. Lured by the aroma of the food, she went to the kitchen.

Ying Chanxi followed behind, and the four of them squeezed into the small kitchen.

Li Luo had just finished stir-frying a dish when he reached out and slapped away Yan Zhusheng's little paw as she tried to sneak a bite. "It's almost ready, don't sneak food. Have you washed your hands?"

"I have."

"At least use a pair of chopsticks."

"I feel like it tastes better when you sneak it with your hands."

"...What kind of absurd logic is that." As Li Luo spoke, he swatted away Ying Chanxi's little paw too. "What's with you two? Do you both like to sneak food?"

"Look, senior is sneaking some too!" With her sharp eyes, Ying Chanxi spotted Xu Youyu's subtle movement.

But by then, Xu Youyu had already succeeded, happily munching on a piece of pork rib in her mouth. She giggled and ran off, not letting Li Luo catch her.

And just like that, the kitchen became lively.

Li Luo was outnumbered, and they managed to snatch several bites. Their little hands were all greasy, making Li Luo not know whether to laugh or cry.

"Alright, alright, I just have one more dish to go," Li Luo said. "Why don't you guys take these dishes out first."

"Got it." Ying Chanxi went to the sink to wash her hands, then obediently started carrying the dishes out.

Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng followed suit, and soon all the dishes were on the dining table.

By twelve-thirty in the afternoon, six dishes and one soup were all served.

The four of them sat around the table, enjoying the first lunch of 2015.

Xu Youyu even went to get a can of beer, while Li Luo poured juice for the other two.

The four of them clinked their glasses and started to eat, wishing each other:

"Happy New Year's Day!"

(End of this chapter)
